currentDecision: Continue Phase 0; the current artifact groups Recovery backup/restore, repair/platform, and local-retirement controls behind labelled native disclosures while preserving existing IDs and owner paths. It also retains the strict pre-delivery Effect/Outbox withdrawal owner and removes undo affordances after execution starts or becomes ambiguous, alongside the independent dependency-free last-resort recovery console at ./recovery.html, deterministic human-readable and artifact-originals exports, and a storage-owned retirement gate requiring a current full Vault readback or separately recorded explicit destroy intent. Compact Recovery keeps low-frequency data-exit and Effect/Outbox controls collapsed by default and leaves hard clear disabled until authorized. The current compact grouping is browser-qualified but does not close the remaining deployment, target/accessibility, native fault, or human-acceptance gaps. OMN-ACC-094 remains bounded NOT_APPLICABLE and no completion or production-release claim is made.
